name: AFFiNE
description: AFFiNE's reviewed updater integration configures an update feed, checks for updates, and downloads automatically when its setting permits; it records the update-ready event for installation. The reviewed application code does not independently establish SHA-512 or OS code-signing enforcement, which remain delegated or unresolved.
limitations: The checkout is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
The WindowsUpdater implementation, electron-updater internals, generated manifests, release assets, and OS signing enforcement were not established by this file.
